Standard: The air vehicle's control forces during maneuvering forward flight (greater than 45 KGS) have no local negative gradients, the deflection of the longitudinal cockpit controller does not lead the control force at any frequency below 5 rad/s, unless pilot evaluation determines the air vehicle handling qualities are no worse than Level 2 to include any gradient nonlinearities. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis to assess the control forces in maneuvering flight as specified in MIL-DTL- 32742 Control Forces in Maneuvering Flight paragraph for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. Obtain stick force per g to confirm desired sensing and gradient behavior. Obtain a frequency response of the control deflection to control force and verify no unfavorable controller dynamics lead to stick force lightening (bobweight effect) whereby stick position leads the force. An established threshold defining the lower limit of Level 2 flying qualities is not provided in MIL-DTL 32742, therefore compliance with the standard is expected to be qualitative only. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the control forces in maneuvering flight as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Control Forces in Maneuvering Flight paragraph for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. Obtain stick force per g to confirm desired sensing and gradient behavior. Obtain a frequency response of the control deflection to control force and verify no unfavorable controller dynamics lead to stick force lightening (bobweight effect) whereby stick position leads the force. An established threshold defining the lower limit of Level 2 flying qualities is not provided in MIL-DTL 32742, therefore compliance with the standard is expected to be qualitative only. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the control forces in maneuvering flight as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Control Forces in Maneuvering Flight paragraph for selected combinations of air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. Obtain stick force per g to confirm desired sensing and gradient behavior. Obtain a frequency response of the control deflection to control force and verify no unfavorable controller dynamics lead to stick force lightening (bobweight effect) whereby stick position leads the force. An established threshold defining the lower limit of Level 2 flying qualities is not provided in MIL-DTL 32742, therefore compliance with the standard is expected to be qualitative only.
